title: Zara x Bad Bunny 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-Piece Collection Drops Globally — Named After His Real Name, Created with Creative Director Janthony Oliveras
detail: Bad Bunny's landmark Zara collaboration — a 150-piece 'BENITO ANTONIO' collection named after his real name (Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio) — launched globally at midnight ET on May 21, 2026 via Zara.com and select Zara flagship stores worldwide, including Zara Man Soho (New York), The Grove (Los Angeles), and Miami Brickell. Created with his longtime creative director Janthony Oliveras, the sprawling line spans graphic tees, vibrant bottoms, oversized essentials, caps, and textured outerwear rooted in Puerto Rican cultural identity. The collection was first teased at the Super Bowl LX halftime show on February 8, 2026, when Bad Bunny wore a custom all-white Zara outfit; he then appeared in a custom all-black tuxedo from the line at the 2026 Met Gala (May 4, theme: 'The Aging Body') — completing the look with hyper-realistic aged prosthetics by Mike Marino that made him one of the night's most-discussed attendees. Campaign photography was shot by Stillz, consistent with his long-running visual collaboration with Bad Bunny's aesthetic universe. The global launch coincides with the eve of the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour, which opens tomorrow night (May 22) at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona — both nights sold out, Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years. The collection marks his most expansive ready-to-wear collaboration to date, extending his cultural footprint beyond music into mainstream fashion alongside his ongoing Adidas sneaker and sportswear partnership.
